mentions.name: PricePush
mentions.description: This tool automates localized pricing for mobile apps, calculating PPP-adjusted prices for 190+ countries and pushing them to App Store Connect and Google Play in one click.
mentions.problem: Manually managing prices across 175 Apple storefronts for multiple apps was taking entire weekends.
mentions.audience: Mobile app developers and publishers managing app store prices
mentions.source_excerpt: PricePush (pricepush.app), automating localized pricing for mobile apps. Calculates PPP-adjusted prices for 190+ countries and pushes them to App Store Connect and Google Play in one click. Built it because managing prices across 175 Apple storefronts for my own 8 apps was taking entire weekends.

evidence.value: PricePush (pricepush.app), automating localized pricing for mobile apps.
